units.source_text: 虽然不知有没有人真正来关心，事出蹊跷，

en.t: Although it was unclear whether anyone was truly concerned, the circumstances were suspicious,

units.source_text: 也至少有看热闹的人，

en.t: there were at least people eager to watch the commotion,

units.source_text: 他们的好奇心，一定像忘了摘下的柿子似的熟透了。

en.t: and their curiosity must have ripened completely, like persimmons forgotten on the tree.

units.source_text: 结果，自然而然，教务主任为了打听搜索申请书的填写方法，

en.t: As a result, quite naturally, the director of academic affairs, in order to ask how to fill out a search request form,

units.source_text: 准备上警察局去查问。

en.t: prepared to go to the police station to make inquiries.

units.source_text: 端正严肃的脸背后，

en.t: Behind his proper and solemn face,

units.source_text: 小心地收藏着兴趣盎然的表情……

en.t: he carefully kept hidden an expression full of keen interest...

units.source_text: “姓名：仁木顺平。

en.t: Name: Junpei Niki.

units.source_text: 三十一岁。

en.t: Thirty-one years old.

units.source_text: 一米五十八，五十四公斤。

en.t: One meter fifty-eight, fifty-four kilograms.

units.source_text: 头发稀少，大背头发型，不用头油。

en.t: Sparse hair, worn slicked back, without hair oil.
Eyesight: right 0.8, left 1.0.

units.source_text: 皮肤浅黑，面孔长。

en.t: Slightly dark skin, long face.

units.source_text: 眼睛和眼睛的距离较近，鼻梁低。

en.t: The eyes are set close together, and the bridge of the nose is low.

units.source_text: 下颌方，左耳下方有一明显黑痣，

en.t: Square jaw, with a conspicuous black mole below the left ear,

units.source_text: 除此以外再没有可称之为特征的东西了。

en.t: and apart from that there is nothing else that could be called a distinguishing feature.

units.source_text: 血型AB。

en.t: Blood type AB.

units.source_text: 舌头不灵活，说起话来含糊不清。

en.t: His tongue is clumsy, and when he speaks his words are indistinct.

units.source_text: 内向型，顽固，但人际关系没有特别不好。

en.t: Introverted and stubborn, but his personal relationships are not especially bad.

units.source_text: 服装，大概是采集昆虫时穿的工作服，

en.t: Clothing: probably work clothes worn when collecting insects,

units.source_text: 上面贴的正面照，是两个月前拍的。”

en.t: and the front-facing photograph attached to it was taken two months ago.
